extra.name: FASTONE® Pro Premades Skin Tone Paint Set (6 pack)
extra.description: Six professional grade heavy body acrylic paint colors in skin tones, a starting point for skin tones from light to dark. Pack of six individually colored tubes, 1.3 oz / 36 g each, hand crafted in small batches by Knoxville artist Heather Wolfe.

summary.text: Artists, many of them live wedding and event painters, say these premixed skin tones save mixing time and give a natural, true-to-life base for portraits. They praise the smooth, densely pigmented paint. A few still mix to customize, and one found the set heavy on dark tones.
